data.one_liner: Shows a simple progress dialog that auto‑dismisses when a Future completes.
data.what_it_does: FutureProgressDialog displays a modal loading indicator while an asynchronous operation runs. It automatically closes the dialog when the Future finishes, requiring no manual hide call.
use_when: You need a quick loading indicator for a single async task
You want automatic dismissal without extra code
avoid_when: You need highly custom dialog designs or animations
